theorem bounded_translated_circle_characterization
  (t x y : ℝ)
  (ht_lower : -1 ≤ t)
  (ht_upper : t ≤ 1) :
  (x - t) ^ 2 + 8 * (x - t) + y ^ 2 - 6 * y = 0 ↔
    (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 ∧
      ¬ (x = t - 4 ∧ y = 3) ∧ t - 4 < 0 := by
  have h₁ : (x - t) ^ 2 + 8 * (x - t) + y ^ 2 - 6 * y = 0 ↔ (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 ∧ ¬ (x = t - 4 ∧ y = 3) ∧ t - 4 < 0 := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₂ : (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 := by
        
        have h₃ : (x - t) ^ 2 + 8 * (x - t) + y ^ 2 - 6 * y = 0 := h
        have h₄ : (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - (t - 4)), sq_nonneg (y - 3), sq_nonneg (x - t + 4),
            sq_nonneg (y - 3), sq_nonneg (x - t - 4), sq_nonneg (y - 3 + 3)]
        exact h₄
      have h₃ : ¬ (x = t - 4 ∧ y = 3) := by
        intro h₄
        have h₅ : x = t - 4 := h₄.1
        have h₆ : y = 3 := h₄.2
        have h₇ : (x - t) ^ 2 + 8 * (x - t) + y ^ 2 - 6 * y = 0 := h
        rw [h₅, h₆] at h₇
        norm_num at h₇
        <;> nlinarith
      have h₄ : t - 4 < 0 := by
        nlinarith
      exact ⟨h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
    · 
      rintro ⟨h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
      have h₅ : (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 := h₂
      have h₆ : ¬ (x = t - 4 ∧ y = 3) := h₃
      have h₇ : t - 4 < 0 := h₄
      have h₈ : (x - t) ^ 2 + 8 * (x - t) + y ^ 2 - 6 * y = 0 := by
        
        have h₉ : (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 := h₅
        have h₁₀ : (x - t) ^ 2 + 8 * (x - t) + y ^ 2 - 6 * y = 0 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - (t - 4)), sq_nonneg (y - 3), sq_nonneg (x - t + 4),
            sq_nonneg (y - 3), sq_nonneg (x - t - 4), sq_nonneg (y - 3 + 3)]
        exact h₁₀
      exact h₈
  exact h₁

    (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 ∧
      ¬ (x = t - 4 ∧ y = 3) ∧ t - 4 < 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcircle : (x - (t - 4)) ^ 2 + (y - 3) ^ 2 = 5 ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [h]
  
    have hcenter : ¬ (x = t - 4 ∧ y = 3) := by
      intro hc
      rcases hc with ⟨hx, hy⟩

    have ht_neg : t - 4 < 0 := by
      nlinarith [ht_upper]
  
    exact ⟨hcircle, hcenter, ht_neg⟩
  
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hcircle, _, _⟩
    nlinarith [hcircle]
